## 00. Data Cleaning

```{r, message=F}
# Load libraries
library(nhanesA)
library(dplyr)
library(survey)
```

```{r, message=F}
# Import NHANES 
demo_i <- nhanes('DEMO_I')    # 2015–2016 demographics
demo_j <- nhanes('DEMO_J')    # 2017–2018 demographics
pfas_i <- nhanes('PFAS_I')    # 2015–2016 PFAS
pfas_j <- nhanes('PFAS_J')    # 2017–2018 PFAS
cbc_i <- nhanes('CBC_I')      # 2015–2016 CBC
cbc_j <- nhanes('CBC_J')      # 2017–2018 CBC
hscrp_i <- nhanes('HSCRP_I')  # 2015–2016 CRP
hscrp_j <- nhanes('HSCRP_J')  # 2017–2018 CRP
cot_i <- nhanes('COT_I')      # 2015–2016 serum cotinine
cot_j <- nhanes('COT_J')      # 2017–2018 serum cotinine
```

```{r}
# Bind survey cycles 
demo <- bind_rows(demo_i, demo_j)
pfas <- bind_rows(pfas_i, pfas_j)
cbc <- bind_rows(cbc_i, cbc_j)
hscrp <- bind_rows(hscrp_i, hscrp_j)
cot <- bind_rows(cot_i, cot_j)
```

```{r}
# Merge datasets using Participant SEQN ID 
nhanes <- demo %>%
  left_join(pfas, by = "SEQN") %>%
  left_join(cbc, by = "SEQN") %>%
  left_join(hscrp, by = "SEQN") %>%
  left_join(cot, by = "SEQN")
```

```{r}
# Select variables
nhanes_analysis <- nhanes %>%
  select(SEQN, RIDAGEYR, RIAGENDR, RIDRETH3, INDFMPIR,
         SDMVPSU, SDMVSTRA, WTMEC2YR, WTSB2YR, starts_with("LBX"), LBXWBCSI,
         LBXLYPCT, LBXNEPCT, LBXEOPCT, LBXPLTSI, LBXCOT, LBXHSCRP)
```

```{r}
# Rename variables and create age groups
nhanes_analysis <- nhanes_analysis %>%
  rename(
    Age = RIDAGEYR,
    Sex = RIAGENDR,
    Race_Ethnicity = RIDRETH3,
    Income_Ratio = INDFMPIR,
    Cotinine = LBXCOT,
    CRP = LBXHSCRP,
    WBC = LBXWBCSI,
    Lymphocytes = LBXLYPCT,
    Neutrophils = LBXNEPCT,
    PFOA = LBXNFOA,
    PFOS = LBXNFOS,
    PFNA = LBXPFNA,
    PFHxS = LBXPFHS
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    AgeGroup = case_when(
      Age >= 18 ~ "Adults (≥18)",
      Age >= 12 & Age < 18 ~ "Adolescents (12–17)"
    )
  )
```

```{r}
# Remove participants with NA values
nhanes_analysis <- nhanes_analysis %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(PFOA), !is.na(PFOS), !is.na(PFNA), !is.na(PFHxS),
    !is.na(CRP), !is.na(WBC), !is.na(Lymphocytes), !is.na(Neutrophils),
    !is.na(Cotinine), !is.na(Income_Ratio),
    !is.na(Sex), !is.na(Race_Ethnicity), !is.na(Age)
  )
```

```{r}
# Save unweighted analysis dataset
saveRDS(nhanes_analysis, "data/nhanes_analysis.rds")
```

```{r}
# Log2-transform skewed variables
nhanes_transformed <- nhanes_analysis %>%
  mutate(
    log2_PFOA = log2(PFOA),
    log2_PFOS = log2(PFOS),
    log2_PFNA = log2(PFNA),
    log2_PFHxS = log2(PFHxS),
    log2_CRP = log2(CRP),
    log2_WBC = log2(WBC),
    log2_Cotinine = log2(Cotinine)
  )
```

```{r}
# Apply survey weights (survey weights / # of cycles)
nhanes_weighted <- nhanes_transformed %>%
  filter(!is.na(WTSB2YR)) %>%              # PFAS subsample restriction
  mutate(WTSB4YR = WTSB2YR / 2)            # Divide survey weights by 2 cycles
```

```{r}
# Create survey design object
nhanes_design <- svydesign(
  ids = ~SDMVPSU,
  strata = ~SDMVSTRA,
  weights = ~WTSB4YR,
  nest = TRUE,
  data = nhanes_weighted
)
```

```{r}
# Save weighted objects
saveRDS(nhanes_weighted, "data/nhanes_weighted.rds")
saveRDS(nhanes_design, "data/nhanes_design.rds")
```
